frame.ui.title: Frame analysis
frame.ui.needs-ifc: Open an IFC model to analyse its beams, columns and braces.
frame.ui.aid: An analysis aid, not a code check: forces, reactions and deflections of the members as modeled, by first-order linear analysis. It checks no design code. An engineer checks the model and decides what the numbers mean. The design checks below (steel, concrete) and the seismic loads are separate, optional steps.

frame.ui.assume-note: Members are analysed on their work lines. A beam end with a shear tab is pinned, with an end plate rigid. Select one member to give its ends, or a column’s base, a rule of their own.

frame.rep.not-a-check: An analysis aid, not a code check. No design code is applied; an engineer checks the model, its loads and supports, and decides what the numbers mean.
frame.rep.method-text: Direct stiffness method, linear and first order (no P-delta): Euler–Bernoulli beam-columns with axial, torsion and two bending stiffnesses; end releases by static condensation; loads along members by their shape functions.
frame.rep.units-text: kN, kN·m, mm; rotations in milliradians. Global Z is up; gravity acts along −Z.
frame.rep.signs-text: Largest value along each member, with its sign. N > 0 is tension; My > 0 and Mz > 0 put the local −z and −y side in tension; deflection is measured from the line between the member’s ends.
frame.rep.size-text: {nodes} points, {members} members, {supports} supports, {cases} load cases, {combos} combinations, {dofs} unknowns.
frame.rep.envelope: Envelope: the largest value of every case and combination
frame.des.aid: Steel member checks to a design code, for I-shapes. An aid until an engineer has reviewed it: first-order forces only (no second-order effects), no torsion, no slender or class 4 parts, no connections. It does not replace an engineer’s check.
frame.des.pick: Choose a design code to make load combinations and check the steel members.
frame.des.lengths-note: Bracing is taken at equal spacing along each member from its start; it limits the weak-axis buckling length and the lateral-torsional length. K multiplies the member length (strong axis) and the braced length (weak axis). These values apply to every member.
frame.des.na-note: The recommended values of EN 1990 and EN 1993-1-1. Change them to your country’s National Annex; they are saved with the project.
frame.des.made: {n} combinations made ({clause}). Typed combinations were kept.

frame.des.err.no-combos: Make combinations first: only the combinations made for the code are checked.

frame.des.signs: Utilisation is demand over capacity: 100 % is the limit. Members are coloured on the model: blue little used, green about half, ochre near the limit, red over it, grey not checked.
frame.des.title: Design checks
frame.des.not-reviewed: An aid until an engineer has reviewed it
frame.des.first-order-text: First order. Second-order effects (P-Δ, P-δ, amplification) are not included; check them before relying on a result.

frame.slab.title: Slab reinforcement (ACI 318-19)
frame.slab.aid: The steel a slab made of plates needs, from the plate moments of every strength combination: bending and twisting moments together by the Wood–Armer rule, a layer at the bottom and at the top in each direction, then one-way shear. An aid for an engineer to check.
frame.slab.done: Designed {n} plates in {combos} combinations: the busiest layer is at {util}.
frame.slab.err.no-plates: The model has no plates to design.

It uses the design settings above.
